full_prompt_en: A square monochrome architectural image shows a nearly empty room defined by broad gray walls, a pair of aligned rectangular openings, and a reflective dark floor. The upper half is occupied by an uninterrupted medium-gray wall, whose subtle tonal variation is more noticeable than any surface ornament. A lower white wall begins at the left edge and ends near the center-right, its top a long, perfectly horizontal line. At its right end, a tall black doorway frames a smaller, bright opening farther away, setting up a tunnel of nested rectangles. The inner opening glows near white, while the surrounding passage is almost black, making this narrow vertical sequence the clear focus of the image. To its right, a slim white plane catches stronger light before the main wall resumes in gray. A continuous light band runs along the base of the left wall, as though illumination is skimming the floor from an unseen source. The floor begins just below the midpoint and extends to the foreground, darkening toward the lower edge. It carries a soft, elongated reflection of the bright inner doorway and adjoining white strip, but its slightly mottled surface keeps the reflected shapes from looking perfectly glassy. The space contains no furniture or people, so the eye follows the right angles, changes of value, and quiet depth through the openings. Soft indirect light comes from the far room and along the left wall, leaving gentle falloff rather than hard directional shadows. The overall composition balances large empty gray planes against one concentrated rectangular light path, creating an austere and meditative spatial stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色建筑图像呈现一间近乎空无一物的房间，由宽阔灰墙、两道对齐矩形开口与反光深色地面界定。上半部是一面连续的中灰墙，其细微调性变化比任何表面装饰更明显。一道较低的白墙从左缘开始，止于中央偏右，其顶部是一条长而完全水平的线。在右端，一道高大的黑色门洞框住更远处较小的明亮开口，形成层叠矩形的通道。内部开口近乎白色，周围通道则近乎黑色，使这列狭窄竖向关系成为图像清楚的焦点。其右侧，一片细窄白色平面接住更强的光，然后主墙又恢复为灰色。左墙底部有一条连续亮带，仿佛光从看不见的来源擦过地面。地面从中线稍下方开始，延伸至前景，朝下缘变暗。其上有内部门洞和相邻白色条带柔长的倒影，但略微斑驳的表面让反射不至于像完美玻璃。空间没有家具或人物，视线因此沿直角、明暗变化和透过开口的安静纵深行进。柔和间接光从远处房间和左墙底部到来，留下渐变的亮度衰减，而非硬质定向阴影。整体构图以大面积空灰平面平衡一条集中的矩形光路，形成严峻而冥想式的空间静止。
style_prompt_en: The image reduces space to large matte planes, right angles, and a small sequence of luminous openings. A restrained gray scale carries subtle shifts in surface value, while near-black recesses and near-white inner planes provide concentrated contrast. Straight edges remain exact, but reflected light softens on a slightly mottled lower surface. Illumination is indirect and linear, skimming edges and fading gradually across broad areas instead of producing many separate highlights. Generous negative space leaves the focal geometry isolated and gives depth to the otherwise sparse frame. The overall treatment is severe, quiet, and precise.
style_prompt_zh: 图像把空间缩减为大片哑光平面、直角和一小列发亮开口。克制的灰阶承载细微表面明暗变化，近黑凹处与近白内部平面提供集中的对比。直线边缘精确，但反射光在略斑驳的下方表面柔化。照明间接且线性，擦过边缘并在宽阔区域逐渐衰减，而非制造许多分散高光。大量负空间让焦点几何孤立，也为稀疏画面增添纵深。整体处理严峻、安静而精确。
theme_en: A quiet monochrome room with aligned doorways and a reflective floor
theme_zh: 一间有对齐门洞与反光地面的寂静单色房间
name: Minimalist composition
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
